subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB333
title: Authorizes landowners who meet certain criteria to petition for formation of a predator damage control district as a funding mechanism to pay the actual costs to the county of preventing, reducing and mitigating damage to property from predatory animals.
headline: SB 333 did not pass

claims.text: SB 333 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 333 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
